title: Migo Linux GNU package manifest v1
description: Describes one shipped Linux GNU slice. Every field is a claim scripts/test-linux-sdk-contract.sh checks against the staged package, so the manifest cannot drift from the artifact it describes.

abi.description: Userspace ABI, not kernel. Android and OpenHarmony are Linux kernels with different, non-interchangeable userspaces.

glibc_floor.description: Highest GLIBC_* symbol version the package may require. Verified against the built binaries by the SDK contract, not merely declared.

glibcxx_floor.description: Highest GLIBCXX_* symbol version the package may require.

dynamic_dependencies.description: DT_NEEDED entries of the shipped shared library, sorted and unique.

snapshot_policy.description: Stated explicitly so that shipping no snapshot is distinguishable from forgetting one. Must agree with the snapshots array.

v8.description: Provenance of the V8 this package was linked against, copied from the V8 component manifest. Its target must equal this package's target: a V8 built for another OS, ABI or arch cannot be mixed in.

artifacts.description: Shipped file names mapped to their size in bytes.
